- Mechanical Engine Modifier: +0.2, making Create golem fix itself faster than other golems even when unpowered.
- Mechanical Mobility Effect: +0.2 per level, effectively another power bonus
- Mechanical Force Effect: +0.1 per level, effectively another power bonus
This config value puts a factor on above bonuses.
 Default: 1.0
 Range: 0.0 ~ 10.0
Mechanical Arm: bonus speed when golem is fueled up

At default speed of 0.5 and bonus of 1, golems fix itself 3 times faster when powered.
 Default: 1.0
 Range: 0.0 ~ 4.0

Animation at speed of 1 is 5 seconds. At speed of 0.5, it takes the arm 10 seconds to perform a fix.
 Default: 0.5
 Range: 0.1 ~ 4.0
